title: Google expands Personal Intelligence, which lets users connect their Google accounts for tailored Gemini answers, to India, initially for AI Pro and Ultra users (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
summary: Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch: Google expands Personal Intelligence, which lets users connect their Google accounts for tailored Gemini answers, to India, initially for AI Pro and Ultra users — Google announced on Tuesday that it's bringing Gemini's Personal Intelligence feature to users in India.
